Package app.vcampus.client.net

Class NettyHandler

java.lang.Object
io.netty.channel.ChannelHandlerAdapter
io.netty.channel.ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter
io.netty.channel.SimpleChannelInboundHandler<String>
app.vcampus.client.net.NettyHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.netty.channel.ChannelHandler, io.netty.channel.ChannelInboundHandler
public class NettyHandler extends io.netty.channel.SimpleChannelInboundHandler<String>
Netty客户端处理器，负责处理入站和出站消息。 继承自SimpleChannelInboundHandler，用于处理特定类型的入站消息（此处为String）。
